author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
A huge h/t to Collin and Jim for such a wonderful job supporting the fire victims.

The brew master followed Sierra Neveda's recipe to the T. I wouldn't mess with Duncan Heins Chocolate Chip Cookie Recipe either.. 

The beer came out amazing. A nice overall balance, no blast of a melted orange Creamsicle or rush of malt covering up unbalanced hops bitterly ripping at your throat.

IPA the way IPAs were meant to be. 

Best yet 100% of proceeds get donated for fire victims and all materials were donated.

If you are looking for something to do swing down to the bridge.
